Background Interaction Steps

FG/BG Interaction

The FG/BG Interaction settings panel is at the bottom of the Workflow sidebar, below Chart Options, and starts collapsed. Without a Background binding it is locked and its controls are hidden. After enabling Background Streaming in Setup, expand the panel and select Enable FG/BG Interaction to unlock interaction Steps. Removing the last unreferenced Background binding disables Interaction but retains the capacity value. Max Active Command Status defaults to 4096 and accepts 1–65536. It is shared across Backgrounds for commands still being tracked, not cumulative commands in a Run. Both settings are saved with the Template. Version 0.3.0 requires the current Template format; older Templates without these settings cannot be loaded.

First enable Background Streaming for the Tool Instance in Setup, then add Worker ON before interaction Steps. Interaction does not start a Worker automatically. Capture may remain OFF.

  • BG Command: supports Meters Software (Simple) and Serial Send / Send File. For Meters, in Background Setup select Trigger with BG Command; this replaces the automatic timer. The Step succeeds when the Worker accepts the trigger. Select Wait for Completion to wait for its measurement within the same Step. For Serial, select Send or Send File and configure TX using the same inputs as Foreground; no additional enable switch is needed. Wait for Completion waits for the TX job.
  • Get Latest: returns the newest native Background event. Missing or invalid newest data fails the Step; it does not substitute an older valid reading.
  • Wait Next: waits for the first event arriving after the Step starts. The first invalid event fails the Step. It can wait for a Source that is starting, but fails immediately once the Source has ended.
  • Get Command Result: select the earlier Source BG Command Step. It waits for that command's completion and result, then returns the native event. In a Loop, the source must have run in the applicable iteration. A source skipped by an IF branch fails the Get; another command's result is never substituted.

Get Steps expose the complete native event as Step Output, for example Meters /value in an existing Binding or Output: choose Previous step result, select the Get Step, then choose a common field under Result, or use Custom pointer... to enter a JSON Pointer. BG Command itself supplies no data output; Get Command Result resolves its invocation internally by source Step. Latest/Next also support existing Scopes numeric cycles and Serial RX events. Command/Result is unavailable for Custom batches and Scopes. Serial Command/Result supports TX only; Latest/Next continue to return RX events. Powers and Wavegen do not support Background.

Step timeout (ms) is optional; blank uses the action timeout. One deadline covers the whole Step. Each Background can retain one requested result; consume it before sending another command whose result is needed. Busy or capacity limits fail immediately without queuing. A command failure after acceptance fails the Run and starts cleanup, even though its dispatch Step already succeeded. An uncertain dispatch is not retried. If an IF skips Get Command Result, the result remains reserved until its enclosing Loop iteration ends, or until Run end for a command outside Loops. Consume it before sending another command whose result is needed in the same scope.

Normal Run end waits for outstanding commands with one action timeout. Worker OFF waits for required commands within its own deadline. Unread results add no wait; existing finite sample-count and capture-quality rules still apply. Stop Workflow uses cooperative cleanup without extra ordinary command waits. Worker OFF and a new Worker ON invalidate old data/result references. If shutdown cannot be confirmed, the same resource remains blocked even if you switch to timer triggering or Foreground use. Verify the external tool is stopped before restarting the application; restarting alone does not verify shutdown.
